description: Led Angular modernization for enterprise apps, built an AI-first SaaS platform from scratch, and delivered accessible, production-ready UIs for multiple clients.
Owned critical features on a code review platform for 80k+ developers. Drove data-driven improvements that delivered 25+ SWE annual productivity savings.
Rebuilt SBB ticket vending machine UI for 1,000+ terminals. Owned state machine logic for payment and transactions. Worked with disability advocates to ensure accessibility compliance.
Developed immersive VR and AR applications using Unity with the goal to explore benefits in various business sectors.
Explored and implemented a custom interior control app for the users smartphone, focusing on improving user experience and comfort.
Lead front end development in a small team developing a platform-agnostic smart home app.
Implemented an in-car VR prototype and reasearched user acceptance and motion sickness.
